# a2a transport

<!-- Generated from the command definitions; do not edit. -->

Work with transport plugins

```
a2a transport <command>
```

The [global flags](a2a.md#global-flags) apply too.

## a2a transport list

List installed transport plugins discovered on PATH

```
a2a transport list
```

**Examples**

```bash
a2a transport list
a2a transport list -o json
```
